### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl (github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl)</summary>

### [`v1.6.0`](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/releases/tag/v1.6.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0)

#### What's Changed

- Upgrade golangci-lint to v2 by [@​o-love](https://redirect.github.com/o-love) in [#​186](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/186)
- docs: Move contribution guidelines to CONTRIBUTING.md by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​193](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/193)
- lib: Add CheckpointAnnotationPodUID annotation by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​194](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/194)
- ci: Add library size check workflow by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​196](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/196)
- lib: Add CheckpointedPodOptions structure by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​195](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/195)
- lib: Add Annotations field to CheckpointedPodOptions by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​197](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/197)
- lib: Rename ReadContainerCheckpointPodOptions to ReadCheckpointPodOptions by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​200](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/200)
- Added the `diff` command - for enabling forensic analysis of checkpoint differences in Kubernetes  by [@​Lorygold](https://redirect.github.com/Lorygold) in [#​192](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/192)
- Removed unneeded open file in internal/container.go by [@​ImranullahKhann](https://redirect.github.com/ImranullahKhann) in [#​203](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/203)
- Add plugin system for external subcommands by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​202](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/202)
- chore(deps): Bump github.com/checkpoint-restore/go-criu/v8 from 8.1.0 to 8.2.0 in the all group by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​204](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/204)
- Refactor inspect to use single data collection phase by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​201](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/201)
- make: allow build variables to be overridden by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​207](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/207)
- Display network information of checkpoints created with Podman by [@​nishantxscooby](https://redirect.github.com/nishantxscooby) in [#​206](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/206)
- fix diff command registration order by [@​hxadogar](https://redirect.github.com/hxadogar) in [#​212](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/212)
- ci: install git in the Fedora container by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​214](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/214)
- checkpointctl: fix lint issue by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​216](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/216)
- Add weekly CI container build for pre-installed test dependencies by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​215](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/215)
- add missing diff socket logic by [@​hxadogar](https://redirect.github.com/hxadogar) in [#​210](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/210)
- ci: use pre-built CI container in coverage and test workflows by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​217](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/217)
- ci: add git safe.directory to CI container image by [@​adrianreber](https://redirect.github.com/adrianreber) in [#​218](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/218)
- chore(deps): Bump github.com/checkpoint-restore/go-criu/v8 from 8.2.0 to 8.3.0 in the all group by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​219](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/219)
- chore(deps): Bump github.com/checkpoint-restore/go-criu/v8 from 8.3.0 to 8.4.0 in the all group by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​220](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/220)
- fix: memparse sub-command nil pointer by [@​englandbaron](https://redirect.github.com/englandbaron) in [#​221](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/221)
- lib: validate non-regular JSON metadata files by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​222](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/222)
- checkpointctl: version 1.6.0 by [@​rst0git](https://redirect.github.com/rst0git) in [#​223](https://redirect.github.com/checkpoint-restore/checkpointctl/pull/223)
